source_comment_body:
The original Methods resolve part of the F3 modification-annotation question in https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/831#issuecomment-6400806453. The original cells are still absent and the canonical nulls are faithful; this is not a parser correction.

In [PMC11874349, ID-MS Data Analysis and Statistics](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11874349/), the authors explicitly state “No additional modifications were included” in the ClipsMS search. Independent XML parsers agree on article.xml#s15. Original article SHA256: 34c2d374b62afe17c48e04bdfd75a5f91e23786db1d537035d632c0f7f411bea; paragraph SHA256: 557facde6e07c61a824c7e71d00b1025847dd578d1ac63c24d0c6680f79f7282.

The official [ClipsMS source at 8ad829b](https://github.com/loolab2020/ClipsMS/tree/8ad829bdb5d2b644a290551442a8728b3b8ac5b5) supports a zero-mass None convention. It was inspected statically, never executed. This does not identify the study software version or prove the workbook export roundtrip. The study Methods, not blank cells alone, support the search assignment; biochemical purity is not established.

PR848 now adds a separate method-supported recipe. It keeps raw nulls, original source generation and both strict recipes unchanged, and emits typed method assertions with source/paragraph hashes and scope. A blank unlocalized field qualifies only alongside explicitly zero localized/terminal shifts and the qualified declaration. All other gates remain unchanged. Independent replay admits 236 primary and 189 later-time cells across the three organs, with 155 baseline measurements; all 8,138 source decisions replay.

The registered frozen-model comparison then fails its biological screen: sequence RMSE 0.288802 versus no-change 0.216691; exact/conditional-score physical models are also worse. No fit or threshold adjustment used F3. The source-policy interpretation is qualified, but the precursor-gain/scan-normalization/calibration and original preparation/machinery metadata requests in this issue remain open. No concentration or APC validation is claimed.
pr_title: Add source-bound organ changes with explicit search-policy provenance
pr_body:
Original PXD058121 F3 organ time courses now have shared, replayable endpoints for changes in log10(product/intact) signal from supplied zero-time baselines. Both recipes retain baseline/normalizer provenance, exclude unsupported or ambiguous assignments and recorded F2 acquisition reuse, and keep future quantities out of covariates. These endpoints do not calibrate concentrations.

`pxd058121_organ_baseline_change_v1` requires explicit unmodified rows. `pxd058121_organ_method_baseline_change_v1` additionally accepts missing unlocalized annotations only when localized/terminal shifts are explicitly zero and the original study Methods declare no additional search modifications. The latter snapshots the pinned article and emits typed method evidence with source/paragraph hashes and scope. Raw nulls and the original source generation remain unchanged. The existing F2 endpoint and strict F3 outputs are identical to their pinned implementations. Version 2.0.41.

Validation: format/lint pass; 30 focused checks include source-scope failures, contradictory values, rehashed tampering, raw-null preservation and exact strict-F2/F3 parity. The default suite passes 3,594 tests. Real-source admission and independent replay verify all 8,138 decisions, 155 baselines and 425 future cells (236 primary, 189 later). The strict recipe correctly admits zero cells. Original Methods support the separate search interpretation, not biochemical purity or the exact export roundtrip.

The downstream frozen-model comparison fails its no-change baseline; the recipe faithfully records that result and does not select or fit predictors. New-head hosted checks and tested PyPI release remain required before shipping.

Closes #847. Related source/provenance dependency #831 remains open for preparation/machinery and scan/normalization/calibration metadata.
